name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Faster settings page. Opening settings no longer waits on a friend's server that is asleep: each friend's libraries are now asked for at the same time with a 10 second limit, and one that does not answer shows as not responding on its own row instead of holding up the whole list. The slow scan for better-quality copies (about 11 seconds on a large library) no longer runs every time the page opens; it runs when you open the Storage tab, in the background, and its result is kept for five minutes.
